# Data samples: us-equities

Every data type of `us-equities` as a real record of the committed test data, every field explained from its data contract, the fields only other rows have and a checklist for the production query. The [index](README.md) lists every domain.

<a id="us-company"></a>

## US company: us-company (USEQ)

A US listed company: key facts, ten years of annual financials, recent SEC filings and index memberships, from public data. One row per us company, keyed by TICKER. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (lake table `us-equities.us-company`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (drishti.py feed run us-equities), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 586 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/us-company/` + `us-company.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `TICKER` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `TICKER`, `NAME`, `LEI_LEGAL_NAME`, `CIK`, `LEI`, `EXCHANGE`, `INDEX_TEXT`, `SECTOR`, `SIC`, `SIC_DESCRIPTION`, `STATE_OF_INCORPORATION`, `REVENUE` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | string | required | The company's primary ticker (SEC company tickers file): the record's key. | — | `"WRB"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The company's name: its Wikidata label, else the SEC name in title case. | — | `"W. R. Berkley"` |
| `SEC_NAME` | string | required | The company's name as SEC EDGAR registers it (submissions name). | — | `"BERKLEY W R CORP"` |
| `CIK` | string | required | The SEC Central Index Key, ten digits with leading zeros (text, never a number). | — | `"0000011544"` |
| `OTHER_TICKERS` | string | optional (filled in 18% of rows) | The company's other tickers on EDGAR (preferred shares, other classes), comma separated; empty when none. | — | `"WRB-PE, WRB-PF, WRB-PG, WRB-PH"` |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | required | The exchanges EDGAR lists the company's securities on, comma separated (Nasdaq, NYSE...). | — | `"NYSE, NYSE, NYSE, NYSE, NYSE"` |
| `LISTING` | string | required | The listing market from the Nasdaq Trader symbol directory (for example Nasdaq Global Select Market). | seen: `New York Stock Exchange`, `Nasdaq Global Select Market`, `Nasdaq Global Market`, `Cboe BZX` | `"New York Stock Exchange"` |
| `SIC` | string | required | The SEC Standard Industrial Classification code (four digits, text). | — | `"6331"` |
| `SIC_DESCRIPTION` | string | required | The company's SIC industry in words, as EDGAR gives it (sicDescription). | — | `"Fire, Marine & Casualty Insurance"` |
| `DIVISION` | string | required | The letter of the SIC division the code falls in (A to J); empty when unclassified. | — | `"H"` |
| `SECTOR` | string | required | The name of the SIC division (Manufacturing, Finance, Insurance and Real Estate...), or Unclassified. | — | `"Finance, Insurance and Real Estate"` |
| `STATE_OF_INCORPORATION` | string | optional (filled in 92% of rows) | The state (or country) code of incorporation, as EDGAR gives it. | — | `"DE"` |
| `FISCAL_YEAR_END` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The fiscal year end as MM-DD (EDGAR fiscalYearEnd). | — | `"12-31"` |
| `FILER_CATEGORY` | string | optional (filled in 99% of rows) | The SEC filer category (Large accelerated filer, Non-accelerated filer...). | seen: `Large accelerated filer`, `Non-accelerated filer`, `<br>Emerging growth company` | `"Large accelerated filer"` |
| `HEADQUARTERS` | string | optional (filled in 83% of rows) | The headquarters city, from Wikidata. | — | `"Greenwich"` |
| `BUSINESS_ADDRESS` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The business address's city and state or country code, from EDGAR. | — | `"GREENWICH, CT"` |
| `FOUNDED` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 83% of rows) | The date the company was founded (YYYY-MM-DD), from Wikidata. | — | `"1967-01-01"` |
| `WEBSITE` | string | optional (filled in 83% of rows) | The company's website: Wikidata's, else EDGAR's. | — | `"http://www.wrberkley.com/"` |
| `PHONE` | string | required | The business phone number, from EDGAR. | — | `"2036293000"` |
| `LEI` | string | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | The company's Legal Entity Identifier (20 characters), from Wikidata or matched in GLEIF by legal name; empty when none was found. | — | `"SQOAGCLKBDWNVYV1OV80"` |
| `LEI_LEGAL_NAME` | string | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | The legal name GLEIF registers for the LEI. | — | `"W. R. BERKLEY CORPORATION"` |
| `LEI_STATUS` | string | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | The LEI's registration status in GLEIF (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, DUPLICATE...). | one of `DUPLICATE`, `ISSUED`, `LAPSED`, `RETIRED` | `"ISSUED"` |
| `LEI_SOURCE` | string | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | How the LEI was found: from Wikidata (checked in GLEIF), matched in GLEIF by legal name, or Wikidata only. | one of `GLEIF, LEI from Wikidata`, `GLEIF, matched by legal name`, `Wikidata` | `"GLEIF, LEI from Wikidata"` |
| `INDEXES` | array of objects | required (filled in 91% of rows) | The indices and lists the company is in, one element each: INDEX (DJIA, NDX, SP500, BANKS-US …), NAME and SINCE; empty when it is in none. | — | [1 objects] |
| `INDEXES[].INDEX` | string | required | The index or list code (SP500, NDX, DJIA, BANKS-US, BANKS-UK, BANKS-CA). | one of `BANKS-CA`, `BANKS-UK`, `BANKS-US`, `DJIA`, `NDX`, `SP500` | `"SP500"` |
| `INDEXES[].NAME` | string | required | The index or list name. | one of `Canadian banks`, `Dow Jones Industrial Average`, `Major UK banks`, `Major US banks`, `Nasdaq-100`, `S&P 500` | `"S&P 500"` |
| `INDEXES[].SINCE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 32% of `INDEXES[]` entries) | The date the company joined the index, from Wikidata, YYYY-MM-DD; empty when Wikidata gives none. | — | `"2019-12-05"` |
| `INDEX_TEXT` | string | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | The names of the indexes and lists the company is a member of, comma separated. | — | `"S&P 500"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The currency the company reports its XBRL financials in (USD for most; a 40-F or 20-F filer may report in CAD, EUR, GBP). | one of `CAD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `USD` | `"USD"` |
| `FISCAL_YEAR` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The latest fiscal year with figures: the year of REVENUE, NET_INCOME, ASSETS, LIABILITIES, EQUITY and EPS_DILUTED (an integer). | seen: `2025`, `2026` | `2025` |
| `REVENUE` | integer | optional (filled in 96% of rows) | Total revenue of FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap Revenues, else RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, else net sales), in CURRENCY. | unit: CURRENCY | `14707856000` |
| `NET_INCOME` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | Net income (loss) attributable to the company for FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap NetIncomeLoss, else ProfitLoss), in CURRENCY; a loss negative. | unit: CURRENCY | `1779403000` |
| `ASSETS` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | Total assets at the latest fiscal year end (us-gaap Assets, else liabilities and equity). | unit: currency units of CURRENCY | `44071071000` |
| `LIABILITIES` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | Total liabilities at the latest fiscal year end (us-gaap Liabilities, else liabilities and equity less total equity). | unit: currency units of CURRENCY | `34359177000` |
| `EQUITY` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | Stockholders' equity at the end of FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap StockholdersEquity), in CURRENCY; a number, not a link. | unit: CURRENCY; links to `equity` | `9700818000` |
| `EPS_DILUTED` | number | optional (filled in 97% of rows) | Diluted earnings per share for FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap EarningsPerShareDiluted, else basic), in CURRENCY per share. | seen: `-3`, `6`, `-4`, `17`; unit: CURRENCY per share | `4.45` |
| `SHARES_OUTSTANDING` | integer | optional (filled in 92% of rows) | Common shares outstanding on the cover of the latest annual report (dei EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding). | unit: shares | `374490856` |

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `TICKER` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `TICKER`, `NAME`, `SEC_NAME`, `CIK`, `EXCHANGE`, `LISTING`, `SIC`, `SIC_DESCRIPTION`, `DIVISION`, `SECTOR`, `PHONE`, `INDEXES`, `CURRENCY`, `FINANCIALS`, `FACTS`, `FILINGS`, `INDEX_IDS`, `FACT_IDS`, `FILING_IDS`, `LATEST_FILING`, `SIC_SECTOR`, `PRICE_HISTORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `TICKER` per snapshot.

<a id="index-membership"></a>

## Index members: index-membership (IDX)

An equity index's members (Dow 30, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500) as their tracking ETF reports holding them; a click opens the member's summary beside. One row per index members, keyed by INDEX. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (lake table `us-equities.index-membership`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (drishti.py feed run us-equities), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 6 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/index-membership/` + `index-membership.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `INDEX` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `INDEX`, `NAME`, `MEMBERS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 6 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "INDEX": "SP500",
  "NAME": "S&P 500",
  "MEMBERS": 495,
  "ROWS": [
```

<a id="filing-feed"></a>

## EDGAR filings browser: filing-feed (EDGAR)

The filings browser: the latest SEC filings of the covered companies, of every form or one; a click opens a filing beside. One row per edgar filings browser, keyed by FEED. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (lake table `us-equities.filing-feed`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (drishti.py feed run us-equities), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 6 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/filing-feed/` + `filing-feed.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `FEED` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `FEED`, `NAME`, `FILINGS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## SEC filing: filing (FILING)

One SEC filing: its company, form, dates, 8-K items and its links on EDGAR (metadata only; the document stays on sec.gov). One row per sec filing, keyed by ACCESSION. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (lake table `us-equities.filing`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (drishti.py feed run us-equities), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 11,691 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/filing/` + `filing.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `ACCESSION` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ACCESSION`, `COMPANY`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `FORM`, `FILED`, `REPORT_DATE` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

<a id="financial-fact"></a>

## Financial fact: financial-fact (FACT)

One financial concept of one company (revenue, net income, assets...) over up to ten fiscal years, from its 10-K XBRL filings. One row per financial fact, keyed by FACT_ID. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (lake table `us-equities.financial-fact`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (drishti.py feed run us-equities), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 4,026 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/financial-fact/` + `financial-fact.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `FACT_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `FACT_ID`, `COMPANY`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `CONCEPT`, `LABEL`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 4,026 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "FACT_ID": "ABT-REVENUE",
  "COMPANY": "ABT",
  "COMPANY_NAME": "Abbott Laboratories",
  "CIK": "0000001800",
  "CONCEPT": "REVENUE",
  "LABEL": "Revenue",
  "UNIT": "USD",
  "XBRL_TAG": "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax",
  "LATEST": 44328000000,
  "LATEST_YEAR": 2025,
  "YEARS": 10,
  "HISTORY": [
    {
      "YEAR": 2016,
      "PERIOD_END": "2016-12-31",
      "VALUE": 20853000000,
      "FILED": "2019-02-22",
      "ACCESSION": "0001047469-19-000624"
    },
    {
      "YEAR": 2017,
      "PERIOD_END": "2017-12-31",
      "VALUE": 27390000000,
      "FILED": "2020-02-21",
      "ACCESSION": "0001104659-20-023904"
    },
    "… 8 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "_meta": {
    "source": "sec-edgar",
    "dataset": "XBRL companyfacts (10-K)",
    "retrievedAt": "2026-10-24",
    "generation": 1
  }
}
```

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FACT_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | — | `"ABT-REVENUE"` |
| `COMPANY` | string | required | The company: a TICKER of the us-company kind. | links to `us-company` | `"ABT"` |
| `COMPANY_NAME` | string | required | The company's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). | — | `"Abbott Laboratories"` |
| `CIK` | string | required | The company's SEC Central Index Key, ten digits with leading zeros (text). | — | `"0000001800"` |
| `CONCEPT` | string | required | Which financial figure the record is: REVENUE, NET_INCOME, ASSETS, LIABILITIES, EQUITY, EPS_DILUTED or SHARES_OUTSTANDING. | one of `ASSETS`, `EPS_DILUTED`, `EQUITY`, `LIABILITIES`, `NET_INCOME`, `REVENUE`, `SHARES_OUTSTANDING` | `"REVENUE"` |
| `LABEL` | string | required | The concept in words (Revenue, Net income, Total assets, Total liabilities, Stockholders' equity, Diluted EPS, Shares outstanding). | one of `Diluted EPS`, `Net income`, `Revenue`, `Shares outstanding`, `Stockholders' equity`, `Total assets`, `Total liabilities` | `"Revenue"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | The unit of LATEST and HISTORY[].VALUE as XBRL reports it: a currency (USD, CAD …), USD/share for EPS, or shares. | — | `"USD"` |
| `XBRL_TAG` | string | required | The XBRL tags the values were read from (us-gaap or dei, comma-separated when several years used different tags; a derived value says so, "LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity less equity"). | — | `"RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax"` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The latest fiscal year's value, the last element of HISTORY. | unit: UNIT | `44328000000` |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | integer | required | The fiscal year of LATEST (an integer). | — | `2025` |
| `YEARS` | integer | required | How many fiscal years HISTORY holds. | — | `10` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The figure for each fiscal year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR, PERIOD_END, VALUE, FILED and ACCESSION (the annual report it came from). | — | [10 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].YEAR` | integer | required | The fiscal year (an integer, XBRL fy). | — | `2016` |
| `HISTORY[].PERIOD_END` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The last day of the fiscal year or the balance-sheet date, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2016-12-31"` |
| `HISTORY[].VALUE` | number | required | The figure for that fiscal year, in UNIT. | unit: UNIT | `20853000000` |
| `HISTORY[].FILED` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the annual report carrying the value was filed, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2019-02-22"` |
| `HISTORY[].ACCESSION` | string | required | The EDGAR accession number of that annual report (0001047469-19-000624). | — | `"0001047469-19-000624"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"sec-edgar"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | seen: `XBRL companyfacts (10-K)`, `XBRL companyfacts (20-F)`, `XBRL companyfacts (40-F)` | `"XBRL companyfacts (10-K)"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 4,026 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `FACT_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `FACT_ID`, `COMPANY`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `CIK`, `CONCEPT`, `LABEL`, `UNIT`, `XBRL_TAG`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `YEARS`, `HISTORY` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `FACT_ID` per snapshot.
